titles.en: Preface to the Sacred Teaching, assembled from Wang Xizhi

background: A Tang stele of 672 whose characters were assembled from Wang Xizhi’s calligraphy by the monk Huai Ren, carrying the preface by Taizong and the record by Gaozong.
